description: Dynamic expert-rating soft-prior weights for 2026 forecast models. Ratings are not hard locks; they pull the probability engine and displayed margin toward public expert consensus only when race-specific inputs are thin.

AL-02-2026.reason: External ratings are disabled for the active model because the district has conflicting map assumptions; compare ratings only under an explicit matching scenario.

TX-28-2026.reason: Thin district polling and repeated benchmark divergence; let Lean D consensus materially constrain the probability engine.
